headline: a year of value from CARES, for a marketplace with 1M orders a year
note: Low, base and high values from docs/MARKET_BENCHMARKS.md. Each input is a market benchmark or a labelled team assumption [$]; none is a Pronto figure. The page computes all three scenarios when every input is filled.
formula: (customers kept x orders per year x average order value x margin) + (cases not handled by a person x cost per case) - (cases CARES resolves x compensation above what a person would pay) - (conversations x agent cost)

complaintsPerYear.label: Orders with a complaint, per year
complaintsPerYear.source: [$] 1M orders x 24.4% with a problem (Zion & Zion) x 25 / 50 / 75% that contact support

churnAfterBadOrder.label: Spend lost after a bad order, as customers who leave
churnAfterBadOrder.source: Uber field experiment, 1.5M riders: 5-10% less spend (NBER w25676); high is below Zendesk's 63% stated intention

retainedByCares.label: Share of that loss CARES wins back
retainedByCares.source: Same experiment: a coupon sent right away recovered ~2 points of the 5-10

ordersPerCustomerYear.label: Orders per customer, per year
ordersPerCustomerYear.source: DoorDash Q4 2025: 903M orders / 56M monthly active users; low is half [$]

avgOrderValue.label: Average order value
avgOrderValue.source: DoorDash Marketplace GOV / orders, Q4 2025 and Q2 2026; low [$]

margin.label: Contribution margin per order
margin.source: DoorDash contribution profit 4.7-5.0% of GOV; Uber Delivery segment income ~3.8% of bookings

costPerHumanCase.label: Cost of a case handled by a person
costPerHumanCase.source: Deloitte Digital 2026 Contact Center Survey (2024 and 2026); Gartner assisted contact

resolvedWithoutPerson.label: Share resolved without a person
resolvedWithoutPerson.source: [$] Planning value; the measured share below is test traffic

extraCompensationPerCase.label: Compensation above what a person would pay, per case
extraCompensationPerCase.source: [$] Same policy caps as a person; Risk Detection should make it negative once measured

agentCostPerConversation.label: Agent cost per conversation
agentCostPerConversation.source: Salesforce Agentforce pricing: $2 per conversation, or $0.10 per action x ~4-5 actions (Flex Credits)
